name: Your phone is already a card reader
object: the Stripe Dashboard app's in-person payment options: Tap to Pay, manual card entry, and QR code payment links, with no extra hardware required
audience: small business owners and solo merchants who want to take in-person card payments without buying a terminal
message: This video tells small business owners that their own phone is already a card reader: open the Stripe Dashboard app and start taking payments in minutes.

moments.what: a vertical, phone-screen walkthrough opens on the Stripe wordmark and an "Accept payments in-person" title card, then a tap-to-pay animation showing a $100.00 charge
moments.copy: A walkthrough of how to accept payments in person with just a mobile phone or tablet and the Stripe Dashboard app, no extra hardware required.

moments.what: steps through setup on screen: open and activate a Stripe account, download the Dashboard app, sign in, tap + on the home screen, then tap "Charge a card or send an invoice"
moments.copy: You can collect payments using Tap to Pay with Stripe Terminal, manually entering card details, or sharing a QR code.

moments.what: enters an amount, then shows the tap-to-pay path: a card or digital wallet held to the back of the phone, confirmed with a green checkmark animation
moments.copy: The customer will tap their form of payment to your compatible iPhone or Android device.

moments.what: shows the two alternative paths: typing card details directly into the app, or generating a QR code / payment link for the customer to pay on their own phone
moments.copy: You can also share a QR code for any payment link; once the customer scans it, they can complete payment on their phone.

moments.what: closes on the Stripe wordmark with stripe.com/register and iOS/Android app-store QR codes
moments.copy: Create an account or log in, then visit the Apple App Store or Google Play Store to get started.

cta: create or log into a Stripe account, then download the Dashboard app from the App Store or Google Play, staged as a closing title card with store QR codes
why: Because every step is shown on the exact phone screen a viewer would use, the walkthrough collapses the distance between watching a feature and doing it, and the closing install QR codes turn that confidence into action immediately.
